analysis: Trial succeeded: host validation macro HR@10 was 0.5513 across four categories (Movies_and_TV 0.600, Industrial_and_Scientific 0.635, Electronics 0.395, CDs_and_Vinyl 0.575). Electronics remained the weakest category. Allocated GPU time was 4,873.02 seconds. Disabling TF32 consistently in training and exported inference accompanied successful execution, but the supplied evidence does not establish TF32 as the cause of the earlier failure or quantify its effect on accuracy.
code_summary: Trains one independent recurrent attention model per category with seed 42 and exports one selected checkpoint per category with dataset routing. Item embeddings feed a normalized GRU; each candidate attends causally over contextual history states. An MLP scores concatenated attention context, GRU state, and candidate embedding, plus a jointly trained item bias. Training uses 32 sampled negatives, recency-weighted sampled-softmax loss with auxiliary logistic losses, AdamW, cosine learning-rate decay, gradient clipping, and activation checkpointing. Validation HR@10 selects a single checkpoint, with NDCG breaking ties. Exported inference shares the trained architecture and disables TF32. Verification checks finite scores, candidate permutation and chunk consistency, causal prefixes, and checkpoint reload consistency. No ensembles or separately fitted scoring components are used.
